entries: Official LaunchDarkly MCP Server for feature flag management and experimentation. Enables AI agents to interact with LaunchDarkly APIs for managing feature flags, AI configs, targeting rules, and gradual rollouts across multiple environments.
官方 LaunchDarkly MCP 服务器，用于功能标志管理与实验。让 AI 智能体通过 LaunchDarkly API 管理功能标志、AI 配置、定向规则以及跨多环境的灰度发布。

Provides data retrieval capabilities powered by Chroma, enabling AI models to create collections over generated data and user inputs, and retrieve that data using vector search, full text search, metadata filtering, and more.
提供由 Chroma 驱动的数据检索能力，让 AI 模型可为生成的数据与用户输入创建集合，并通过向量搜索、全文搜索、元数据过滤等方式检索这些数据。

Repositories and issues are available. Pull requests, My Work, cloud workflows, cloud sessions, and Copilot inference are unavailable. A GitHub.com or Enterprise Cloud account remains required for Copilot.
仓库和议题可用。拉取请求、我的工作、云端工作流、云端会话和 Copilot 推理不可用。使用 Copilot 仍需 GitHub.com 或 Enterprise Cloud 账号。
Press Enter or Space to place the selected annotation. Use arrow keys to move an annotation. Hold Alt while pressing an arrow key to resize it. Press Enter to edit a comment.
按 Enter 或空格放置所选标注。使用方向键移动标注。按住 Alt 的同时按方向键可调整其大小。按 Enter 编辑评论。
Automatically archive and delete sessions linked to merged pull requests after they've been inactive. Deleting a session also deletes its workflow runs and can't be undone.
自动归档并删除与已合并的拉取请求相关联的会话（当会话处于不活跃状态时）。删除会话同时会删除其对应的工作流运行，且无法撤消。
Copilot couldn't respond because MCP servers, tools, and instructions are using too much context. Run /context to review context usage and disable anything you don't need.
Copilot 无法响应，因为 MCP 服务器、工具和指令占用了过多上下文。运行 /context 查看上下文用量，并停用不需要的内容。
Look at the pull request file changes and suggest the best matching labels from the repository's available labels. Apply the labels you think are most appropriate.
查看拉取请求的文件更改，从仓库可用标签中推荐最匹配的标签。应用你认为最合适的标签。
MCP server for connecting to Elasticsearch data and indices. Supports search queries, mappings, ES|QL, and shard information through natural language interactions.
用于连接 Elasticsearch 数据与索引的 MCP 服务器。支持通过自然语言交互进行搜索查询、映射、ES|QL 与分片信息操作。
Append a short attribution line to the replies agent merge posts when it resolves review comments, noting they were made automatically by the GitHub Copilot app.
在智能体合并发布的内容中追加一行简短归属说明，表明这是由 GitHub Copilot 应用自动生成的。
Turn this on if your screen reader jumps to new content while a response streams. It keeps earlier messages stable and can use more memory in long conversations.
当屏幕阅读器在响应过程中跳到新内容时启用此项。它能保持较早消息的稳定，但可能消耗更多内存。
Keep this profile short and durable. Do not store secrets or transient task details. Changes apply automatically when My Copilot finishes its current work.
请保持此配置简短且长久有效。不要存储密钥或临时任务细节。当"我的 Copilot"完成当前工作后更改会自动生效。
Include sessions created by the Copilot CLI in the sidebar. Choose how far back to surface them, or turn this off to hide CLI-created sessions entirely.
在侧边栏中包含由 Copilot CLI 创建的会话。选择要回溯显示的时间范围，或关闭此选项以完全隐藏 CLI 创建的会话。
Enables clients like GitHub Copilot and other AI agents to bring trusted and up-to-date information directly from Microsoft's official documentation.
让 GitHub Copilot 等客户端及其他 AI 智能体直接引入来自 Microsoft 官方文档的可信最新信息。
Refine the prompt in a workspace session that drafts a change and proposes it for you to review and apply. Choose what it learns from when you start.
在工作区会话中打磨提示词：它会起草变更并提交给你审阅和应用。开始时选择它的学习来源。
Asks the parent session to inspect the fork worktree and intelligently merge the fork's intended changes without overwriting unrelated parent work.
请求父会话检查分叉工作树，并智能合并分叉的预期更改，而不覆盖父级中无关的工作。
The backend accepted the workspace creation request, but the app did not confirm that the workspace was created. Try starting the session again.
后端已接受工作区创建请求，但应用未能确认工作区已创建。请尝试重新启动会话。
When on, the automation only runs if the user who triggered the event has write access to the repository. Leave off to let any actor trigger it.
开启时，仅当触发事件的用户对该仓库有写入权限时才运行自动化。关闭则允许任何执行者触发。
Removes ${s} from the sidebar. Your main checkout stays, but session worktrees are deleted and recovering uncommitted work from them is manual.
从侧边栏移除 ${s}。主检出不受影响，但会话工作树会被删除，且从中恢复未提交的工作需要手动操作。
An experimental MCP server implementation for Azure AI Foundry that exposes unified tools for models, knowledge, evaluation and deployment.
面向 Azure AI Foundry 的实验性 MCP 服务器实现，为模型、知识、评估与部署提供统一工具。
Zapier MCP is a remote MCP server that gives your AI direct access to 8,000+ apps and 30,000+ actions—no complex API integrations required.
Zapier MCP 是一个远程 MCP 服务器，让你的 AI 直接访问 8,000+ 应用与 30,000+ 操作——无需复杂的 API 集成。
This session couldn't set up remote control, so it was resumed with remote control turned off. You can turn it back on for this session.
此会话无法设置远程控制，因此以关闭远程控制的方式恢复。你可以为此会话重新打开它。
When you close the window, keep GitHub Copilot running in the system tray instead of quitting. Sessions keep running in the background.
关闭窗口后，让 GitHub Copilot 继续在系统托盘中运行而不要退出。会话将在后台继续运行。
Guide how Agent Merge handles authorized work. These instructions never enable additional actions or override Agent Merge safety rules.
指导智能体合并如何处理已授权的工作。这些说明绝不会启用额外操作或覆盖智能体合并的安全规则。
Prefer plain ASCII punctuation in GitHub-bound text. Avoid em dashes, en dashes, and smart quotes when simple ASCII punctuation works.
在面向 GitHub 的文本中优先使用纯 ASCII 标点。当简单 ASCII 标点可用时，避免使用长破折号、短破折号和弯引号。
Force the low disk space warning to appear in the sidebar for design work. The banner appears after disk measurements finish loading.
强制在侧边栏显示低磁盘空间警告以便设计调试。横幅会在磁盘测量加载完成后出现。
Usage and plan data require GitHub Copilot access. Subscribe to Copilot or connect a model provider to continue with your own models.
用量和套餐数据需要 GitHub Copilot 访问权限。请订阅 Copilot，或连接模型提供程序以使用你自己的模型继续。
This stops the session's Copilot CLI process and starts a new one. Queued messages are discarded and any in-flight response is lost.
这将停止会话的 Copilot CLI 进程并启动一个新进程。已排队的消息将被丢弃，进行中的响应将丢失。
Copilot couldn't respond because the response was blocked by content filtering. Try rephrasing your request and sending it again.
Copilot 无法响应，因为响应被内容过滤拦截。请换种说法重新发送。
Paste a gist URL or a GitHub folder URL. The extension installs to this device and stays available across every workspace here.
粘贴 gist URL 或 GitHub 文件夹 URL。扩展将安装在本机，并在该工作区的所有工作空间中可用。
The remote connection recovered, but delivery could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before sending the message again.
远程连接已恢复，但无法确认送达。请检查对话后再重新发送消息。
Local image processing with computer vision capabilities including object detection, OCR, image editing, and transformations.
具备计算机视觉能力的本地图像处理，包括目标检测、OCR、图像编辑与变换。
Connect your self-hosted server to access repositories and issues. Copilot requires a GitHub.com or Enterprise Cloud account.
连接自托管服务器以访问仓库和 Issue。Copilot 需要 GitHub.com 或 Enterprise Cloud 账户。
Limits ensure fair access. Higher multiplier models consume limits faster. Use plan mode or lighter models to reduce usage.
限制有助于保障公平使用。高倍率模型会更快消耗额度。使用计划模式或更轻量的模型以减少使用量。
Preferences that apply to every session across all projects. Copilot may also load instructions from files on this machine.
应用于所有项目所有会话的偏好设置。Copilot 还可能从本机文件加载指令。
Voice dictation types into whichever text box you've selected. Open a workspace or click in a text field, then try again.
语音听写会输入到你选中的任意文本框。请打开工作区或点击一个文本字段，然后重试。
This remote environment is unavailable or could not be found. The session has been kept so you can review or delete it.
此远程环境不可用或未找到。会话已保留，以便你查看或删除。
Review comment locations are still resolving. Review submission is paused to avoid posting comments on outdated lines.
审阅评论位置仍在解析中。为避免在过期行上发布评论，审阅提交已暂停。
Review dismissal could not be confirmed. Refresh the pull request before trying again. Close this dialog to continue.
无法确认审查忽略。请刷新拉取请求后再试。关闭此对话框以继续。
Early-access features that may change or be removed. Help shape the product by trying them out and sharing feedback.
前瞻性功能可能会改变或移除。欢迎试用并反馈意见，帮助我们改进产品。
Usage blocked. Your organization or enterprise has exceeded its Copilot budget. Contact your admin to resume usage.
用量已被阻止。你的组织或企业已超出 Copilot 预算。请联系管理员以恢复使用。
Start new sessions with this agent automatically. A per-session pick or /agent still overrides it for that session.
自动使用此智能体开始新会话；单个会话的选择或 /agent 仍会覆盖该会话的设置。
An external link wants to open a Copilot session. If it isn't set up on this device yet, its project will be added.
外部链接请求打开 Copilot 会话。如果此设备尚未设置，其项目将被添加。
Sessions keep changes until you decide to share them. Review the diff and create a pull request when you're ready.
会话会保留变更，直到你决定分享。准备好后审阅差异并创建拉取请求。
This priority changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Reset to latest to review the new version before saving.
此优先级已在其他地方更改。你的草稿已保留。请重置为最新版本，以在保存前查看新版本。
Interact with Azure DevOps services like repositories, work items, builds, releases, test plans, and code search.
与 Azure DevOps 服务交互，如仓库、工作项、生成、发布、测试计划和代码搜索。
Saved changes were merged with another edit, but newer input could not be rebased. Reopen the editor to continue.
保存的更改已与另一处编辑合并，但较新的输入无法变基。请重新打开编辑器以继续。
Override the Copilot plan and entitlement to test different quota states. Blocks real quota updates while active.
覆盖 Copilot 套餐与权益以测试不同配额状态。启用期间会阻止真实配额更新。
Recording voice dictation shortcut. Press a key combination including at least one modifier, or Escape to cancel.
正在录制语音听写快捷键。请按下包含至少一个修饰键的组合键，或按 Escape 取消。
These files are discovered by the Copilot runtime and applied when enabled. Edit the source file to change them.
这些文件由 Copilot 运行时自动发现，启用后生效。请修改源文件以变更它们。
means that signal is not evaluated because an earlier one already decided. Use Apply on any row to reproduce it.
表示该信号未被评估，因为已有更早的信号做出了决定。可对任意行使用"应用"来复现。
Approval lets the agent continue within the boundary above. It does not confirm that the actions have succeeded.
批准可让智能体在上方边界内继续。它并不确认这些操作已成功。
GitHub doesn't track usage for your configured model providers here. Check usage and billing with each provider.
GitHub 不在此处跟踪你所配置模型提供程序的使用情况。请向各提供程序查询使用量和计费。
The app did not confirm that the workspace creation request reached the backend. Try starting the session again.
应用未能确认工作区创建请求已到达后端。请尝试重新启动会话。
Filters decide which events start a run. The factory instructions still decide whether the event is actionable.
筛选条件决定哪些事件会启动运行。工厂说明仍决定该事件是否可操作。
Request changes denies this call before sending your feedback. Approval allows only the exact call shown above.
“请求更改”会在发送反馈前阻止此调用。“批准”仅允许上述确切调用。
Dispatches the rubber-duck sub-agent for an independent critique of the current approach, plan, or recent work.
派遣小黄鸭子智能体，对当前方法、计划或近期工作给出独立评审。
The selected worktree location overlaps this repository. Choose another location, then start the session again.
所选工作树位置与此仓库重叠。请选择其他位置，然后重新启动会话。
Voice dictation needs a local transcription model. Download one in Settings → Voice dictation, then try again.
语音听写需要一个本地转录模型。请在 设置 → 语音听写 中下载一个，然后重试。
Hide staff-only features, internal settings, model names, and account usage details while sharing your screen.
共享屏幕时隐藏仅员工可见的功能、内部设置、模型名称与账户用量详情。
An external link wants to recover a Copilot session. Review the retained branch before continuing to recovery.
外部链接请求恢复 Copilot 会话。请先检查保留的分支再继续恢复。
Local files for the workspace sessions will be deleted. Any uncommitted work is saved to a recovery ref first.
工作区会话的本地文件将被删除。任何未提交的工作都会先保存到恢复引用。
Access models from other providers with your own API keys. Keys stay private and go straight to the provider.
使用你自己的 API 密钥访问其他提供商的模型。密钥保持私密，并直接发送给提供商。
I manually edited the plan. Please review the latest plan content and update the plan or options accordingly.
我手动编辑了计划。请检查最新计划内容，并相应更新计划或选项。
Cannot specify more than one target parameter. Use only one of 'pr', 'issue', 'branch', and 'source_branch'.
不能指定多个目标参数。只能使用 'pr'、'issue'、'branch' 和 'source_branch' 中的一个。
The repository host is not available yet. Wait for the linked account to load or choose another environment.
仓库主机尚不可用。请等待关联账户加载完成，或选择其他环境。
Delivery could not be confirmed. Check the conversation and use Stop or Restart session before trying again.
无法确认送达。请检查对话，并使用“停止”或“重启会话”后再试。
Your preserved changes couldn't be applied automatically. Run the command below to recover them as a branch.
你保留的更改无法自动应用。请运行以下命令，将它们作为分支恢复。
Parent session not found on this device. Deep links are shareable, so it may only exist on another machine.
在此设备上未找到父会话。深链接可共享，因此它可能只存在于另一台机器上。
Choose the tools and connected context sources available to this factory. Built-in tools remain available.
选择此工厂可用的工具和已连接的上下文来源。内置工具仍然可用。
Couldn't confirm whether the health check logs were attached. Check the issue before attaching them again.
无法确认健康检查日志是否已附加。再次附加前请先查看该议题。
Remove file references and attachments before starting Fleet. Your message and attachments were preserved.
启动工厂集群前请移除文件引用和附件。你的消息和附件已保留。
Runs the same batch assessment on a schedule while this app is open. Nothing runs while the app is closed.
在此应用打开时按计划运行相同的批量评估。应用关闭时不运行任何内容。
Only run for pull requests where the changed files match one or more of these gitignore-style path globs.
仅当更改的文件匹配以下一个或多个 gitignore 风格路径通配符时才运行。
Removes this project from the sidebar and deletes its session worktrees. Your main checkout is untouched.
将此项目从侧边栏移除并删除其会话工作树。你的主检出不受影响。
, the fastest way from idea to merged pull request. Run parallel sessions, track changes, zero conflicts.
, 从想法到合并拉取请求的最快方式。并行运行会话、跟踪变更，零冲突。
MCP servers can run local commands. Review .mcp.json or .github/mcp.json before trusting this repository.
MCP 服务器可以运行本地命令。信任此仓库前，请先检查 .mcp.json 或 .github/mcp.json。
You need a paid GitHub Copilot subscription to continue, or you can use your own API key or local model.
你需要付费的 GitHub Copilot 订阅才能继续，也可以使用自己的 API 密钥或本地模型。
Prevent sleep while a session is active. Keep awake for some additional time after a session goes idle.
在会话处于活动状态时防止电脑进入休眠。当会话闲置后，仍会额外保持唤醒一段时间。
Coordinates the work across multiple sessions and repositories by spawning and steering child sessions.
通过派生和引导子会话，协调跨多个会话和仓库的工作。
GitHub Sandbox is not available for GitHub Enterprise Server repositories. Choose another environment.
GitHub Enterprise Server 仓库无法使用 GitHub 沙盒。请选择其他环境。
This draft was saved in another window while you had newer local input. Reopen the editor to continue.
此草稿在另一窗口中被保存，而你有更新的本地输入。请重新打开编辑器以继续。
. Ones that are running may restart to apply the change, and you can switch again in project settings.
。正在运行的会话可能会重启以应用更改，你可以在项目设置中再次切换。
Automatically archive and delete sessions linked to merged pull requests after they've been inactive.
自动归档并删除与已合并的拉取请求相关联的会话（当会话处于不活跃状态时）。
Clear completed campaigns and return Home so the highest-priority eligible feature highlight appears.
清除已完成的推广并返回主页，以便显示优先级最高的可用功能提示。
The remote host no longer has this session. The session has been kept so you can review or delete it.
远程主机已不再拥有此会话。会话已保留，以便你查看或删除。
Plugins can add skills, agents, MCP servers, and hooks. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
插件可添加技能、智能体、MCP 服务器和钩子。请仅从你信任的来源安装插件。
Connect AI assistants to GitHub - manage repos, issues, PRs, and workflows through natural language.
让 AI 助手通过自然语言连接 GitHub，管理仓库、Issue、PR 与工作流。
List datasets, schemas, run APL queries, and use prompts for exploration, anomalies, and monitoring.
列出数据集与架构、运行 APL 查询，并使用提示词进行探索、异常分析与监控。
Extract data from any website with thousands of scrapers, crawlers, and automations on Apify Store ⚡
借助 Apify Store 上数千个抓取器、爬虫与自动化工具，从任意网站提取数据 ⚡
Solana MCP for wallets, trades, markets, PnL, transfers, onchain data, signable swaps and API tools.
面向钱包、交易、行情、盈亏、转账、链上数据、可签名兑换与 API 工具的 Solana MCP。
Only run for pull requests that match this search filter. Leave blank to run for every pull request.
仅对符合此搜索筛选的拉取请求运行。留空则对所有拉取请求运行。
Provides access to Avalara Tax Registration and Business Licenses APIs for filings and registrations
提供对 Avalara 税务登记与营业执照 API 的访问，用于申报和注册
Runs a self-review of the workspace changes, looking for bugs, regressions, and code quality issues.
对工作区更改进行自审，查找缺陷、回归和代码质量问题。
Open the full sessions table to browse, rename, archive, or delete sessions and free up disk space.
打开完整的会话列表，浏览、重命名、归档或删除会话以释放磁盘空间。
US/HK markets — 163 tools: quotes, options, orders, fundamentals, screener, IPO, alerts, DCA & grid
